Setting.Name: CareOnCloud::TicketAudit::Enabled
Setting.Description: Requires immutable tenant binding and transaction-atomic audit for covered CareOnCloud ESM ticket mutations.

Setting.Name: CareOnCloud::TicketPolicy::Enabled
Setting.Description: Fail-closed tenant filtering for CareOnCloud ESM ticket search and read adapters.

Setting.Name: CareOnCloud::SearchPolicy::Enabled
Setting.Description: Requires a trusted tenant context and mandatory filter for every CareOnCloud Elasticsearch query.

Setting.Name: CareOnCloud::SearchPolicy::TenantSafeIndexes
Setting.Description: Elasticsearch indexes whose documents and final query filter carry the CareOnCloud tenant discriminator.

Setting.Name: Ticket::CustomModule###724-CareOnCloudTicketAudit
Setting.Description: Loads the CareOnCloud transaction and audit wrapper for CareOnCloud ESM ticket repository mutations.
